title: result
description: The structured result a worker session returns (BRIEF 9.4), passed to claude -p as --json-schema and re-validated in code.

provenance.description: a path with a locator the manifest can resolve

heading.description: a finding is a Results passage: the Results heading it stands under, naming the question; reuse one the section already has when it fits (the ticket's title when absent)

replaces.description: the id of the finding this one replaces, when it narrows or corrects it (a scope-down); null otherwise

passages.description: what this ticket adds to the paper's sections (Introduction, Discussion, Methods, References), each written by code into research/sections/; Results is written as findings. A claim sentence ends with its provenance tag, and math is LaTeX ($...$, $$...$$)

heading.description: the heading it stands under; reuse one the section already has when it fits

text.description: Markdown, from one claim to a paragraph

replaces.description: the id of the passage this one replaces (P<n>), or null

references.description: every work the ticket drew on, each by a DOI, an arXiv id, or its exact title (never a URL, which is never looked up), with a note kept on its dossier under the ticket's id and never read by the scout; acceptance looks up each one no dossier holds yet (decision 17; ticket 98)

identifier.description: a DOI, an arXiv id, or the work's exact title; never a URL

note.description: what the ticket drew on the work for; may be empty

touches.description: the touch set the proposed ticket would take; used by admission's duplicate check (ticket 37)

jobs.description: experiment tickets: the job ids a running result leaves for the poller
